name: Doctoral Program in Chemical and Biological Sciences
location: La Jolla, California and Jupiter, Florida

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The page gives an annual December 1 deadline for all materials, without a time or year. The committee begins reviewing applications in early December.

english.note: TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo is required for international applicants; minimum scores are not stated. Scores must be within three years of the deadline. Exemptions exist for study in the US, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand or Canada (outside Quebec).

applicationFee.note: Waivers are available for financial need or hardship; add up to one page explaining it in the application.

documents: WES course-by-course evaluation, highly recommended for degrees from outside the US

funding.note: Support covers tuition, health insurance and a stipend, provided by Scripps Research, the student's advisor and national fellowships. The 2025-26 stipend is $45,760 in California and $43,680 in Florida.

international.note: The page warns that US travel bans or visa suspensions may affect some applicants and suggests checking before paying the fee.
